source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_CRM_CORPDBAINFO WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(STG.[CORPDBAINFOID],0),0) AS CORPDBAINFOID
,STG.[BANK_ID]
,[ENTITY_CREATE_FLG]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CORP_ID],0),0) AS CORP_ID
,[NAME]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BODATECREATED, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as BODATECREATED
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BODATEMODIFIED, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as BODATEMODIFIED
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([BOCREATEDBY],0),0) AS BOCREATEDBY
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([BOMODIFIEDBY],0),0) AS BOMODIFIEDBY
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CONCURDETECT_X],0),0) AS CONCURDETECT_X
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([BOACLID],0),0) AS BOACLID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([EXTENSIONID],0),0) AS EXTENSIONID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([SECURITYILHINT],0),0) AS SECURITYILHINT
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([SECURITYIUHINT],0),0) AS SECURITYIUHINT
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([SECURITYGLHINT],0),0) AS SECURITYGLHINT
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([SECURITYGUHINT],0),0) AS SECURITYGUHINT
,[CORP_KEY]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(TMDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as TMDATE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[CRM_CORPDBAINFO_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_CRM_CORPDBAINFO] STG ON DELTA.CORPDBAINFOID = STG.CORPDBAINFOID AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID
 where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_CRM_CIFGROUPS WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(STG.[GRPID],0),0) AS GRPID
,STG.[BANK_ID]
,[GROUPID]
,[GROUPTYPE]
,[RATING]
,[GROUPNAME_NATIVE]
,[PARENTGROUP]
,[INDUSTRY]
,[PRIMARY_SOL_ID]
,convert(numeric(4,0),ISNULL([RISKRATING],0),0) AS RISKRATING
,convert(numeric(4,0),ISNULL([RISKRATINGMODEL],0),0) AS RISKRATINGMODEL
,convert(date,[RISKRATINGDONEON]) as RISKRATINGDONEON
,convert(numeric(4,0),ISNULL([OVRDN_RISKRATING],0),0) as OVRDN_RISKRATING
,convert(date,[RISKRATING_OVRDNON]) as RISKRATING_OVRDNON
,[RISKRATING_OVRDNBY]
,convert(date,[ANNUALREVIEWDATE]) as ANNUALREVIEWDATE
,convert(date,[INTERIMREVIEWDATE]) as INTERIMREVIEWDATE
,[REVIEWINGTEAM]
,[STRICTREPORTINGMARKER]
,[ONWATCHLIST]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RELATIONSHIP_STDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as RELATIONSHIP_STDATE
,[GROUPNAME]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([RELATIONSHIPMGRID],0),0) as RELATIONSHIPMGRID
,[ISSUSPENDED]
,[NOTES]
,[RELATIONSHIPMGR]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([BOCREATEDBY],0),0) AS BOCREATEDBY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BODATECREATED, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as BODATECREATED
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([BOMODIFIEDBY],0),0) as BOMODIFIEDBY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BODATEMODIFIED, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as BODATEMODIFIED
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CONCURDETECT_X],0),0) as CONCURDETECT_X
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(TMDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as TMDATE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
FROM [BUSC].[CRM_CIFGROUPS_DELTA] DELTA
LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_CRM_CIFGROUPS] STG ON DELTA.GRPID = STG.GRPID AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID
where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
STG.[BANK_ID]
,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(STG.[CATEGORYID],0),0) AS CATEGORYID
,[CATEGORYTYPE]
,[VALUE]
,[DESCRIPTION]
,[DEL_FLG]
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA] DELTA 
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_CRM_CATEGORIES] STG ON DELTA.CATEGORYID = STG.CATEGORYID AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID
 where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_CRM_CBSCUSTCARDDETAILS WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
	STG.CARDNUMBER
	,EMBOSSNAME
	,STG.ACCOUNTID
	,CARDTYPE
	,CARDSUBTYPE
	,CARDSTATUS
	,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,EXPIRYDATE),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS EXPIRYDATE
	,CUSTOMFIELD1
	,CUSTOMFIELD2
	,CUSTOMFIELD3
	,CUSTOMFIELD4
	,CUSTOMFIELD5
	,STG.BANK_ID
	,STG.CIFID
	,1 as isActive
	,1 as isLatest
	,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
	,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,convert(date,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM (SELECT * FROM BUSC.CRM_CBSCUSTCARDDETAILS_DELTA GROUP BY SRC_HR ,TGT_HR ,CIFID ,BANK_ID ,CARDNUMBER ,ACCOUNTID ,isActive ,isLatest ,RECORD_STATUS) DELTA
LEFT JOIN d360.STG_CRM_CBSCUSTCARDDETAILS STG 
    ON DELTA.CIFID = STG.CIFID 
    AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID 
    AND DELTA.CARDNUMBER = STG.CARDNUMBER
    AND DELTA.ACCOUNTID = STG.ACCOUNTID
WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(STG.[PHONEEMAILID],0),0) as PHONEEMAILID
,STG.[BANK_ID]
,[DONOTDISTURB]
,convert(date,[DATEOFREQUEST]) as [DATEOFREQUEST]
,[DNDINITIATEDBY]
,[HOLDEMAILFLAG]
,[PHONEEMAILTYPE]
,[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]
,[PHONEOREMAIL]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CORP_REP_ID],0),0) as CORP_REP_ID
,[HOLDEMAILREASON]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CORP_ID],0),0) as CORP_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([ORGID],0),0) as ORGID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([ACCOUNTID],0),0) as ACCOUNTID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CONTACTID],0),0) as CONTACTID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([SUSPECTID],0),0) as SUSPECTID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([PARTNERID],0),0) as PARTNERID
,[PHONENO]
,[PHONENOLOCALCODE]
,[PHONENOCITYCODE]
,[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
,[WORKEXTENSION]
,[EMAIL]
,[EMAILPALM]
,[URL]
,[PREFERREDFLAG]
,convert(date,[START_DATE]) as [START_DATE]
,convert(date,[END_DATE]) as [END_DATE]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([NONCUSTOMERID],0),0) as NONCUSTOMERID
,[USERFIELD1]
,[USERFIELD2]
,[USERFIELD3]
,convert(date,[DATE1]) as [DATE1]
,convert(date,[DATE2]) as [DATE2]
,convert(date,[DATE3]) as [DATE3]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([EXTENSIONID],0),0) as EXTENSIONID
,[ORGKEY]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LAST_UPDATED_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as  [LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(TMDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as [TMDATE]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[CRM_PHONEEMAIL_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_CRM_PHONEEMAIL] STG ON DELTA.PHONEEMAILID = STG.PHONEEMAILID AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID 
 where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(STG.[GROUPHOUSEHOLDID],0),0) as GROUPHOUSEHOLDID
,STG.[BANK_ID]
,[GROUP_ID]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CORP_REP_ID],0),0) as CORP_REP_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CORP_ID],0),0) as CORP_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([PERSONID],0),0) as PERSONID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([ORGID],0),0) as ORGID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([ACCOUNTID],0),0) as ACCOUNTID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([CONTACTID],0),0) as CONTACTID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([SUSPECTID],0),0) as SUSPECTID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([PARTNERID],0),0) as PARTNERID
,[GROUPHOUSEHOLDCODE]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([GROUPHOUSEHOLDMASTERID],0),0) as GROUPHOUSEHOLDMASTERID
,[FLAG]
,convert(numeric(20,2),ISNULL([SHAREHOLDING_IN_PERCENTAGE],0),0) as SHAREHOLDING_IN_PERCENTAGE
,[TEXT1]
,[TEXT2]
,[TEXT3]
,convert(date,[DATE1]) as DATE1
,convert(date,[DATE2]) as DATE2
,convert(date,[DATE3]) as DATE3
,[DROPDOWN1]
,[DROPDOWN2]
,[DROPDOWN3]
,[LOOKUP1]
,[LOOKUP2]
,[LOOKUP3]
,[GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME]
,[ORGKEY]
,[ADDGROUP_ID]
,[PRIMARY_GROUP_INDICATOR]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL([GRPID],0),0) as GRPID
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(TMDATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as TMDATE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD] STG ON DELTA.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID = STG.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID AND  DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID
 where H = 'D'
